🎉Welcome to Gambit's FXMaster V7.2.1!

This release resolves some masking issues from 7.2. Please check out the Release Notes for more detail.

If you'd like to support my development time and get access to the Gambit's FXMaster+ and Gambit's Asset Previewer modules, please consider supporting the project on Patreon.

FXMaster+ Effects:

  • Ice
  • Sandstorm
  • Duststorm
  • Ghosts
  • Sunlight
  • Magic Crystals
  • Fireflies
  • Sakura Bloom
  • Sakura Blossoms
  • And add your own Particle Effects!

If you have any questions about the module feel free to join the Discord!

Pythor, Bóg Bitwy, jest synem Mytros i Volkana. Podczas Pierwszej Wony nieustępliwie walczył przeciwko centaurom i gyganom.

Ostatnia wojna między Mytros a Aresią odbyła się około 100 lat temu.

"Kiedyś pokochałam mężczyznę, który miał klejnoty za oczy, warkocze jak słońce i usta jak kwiat, twierdził, że urodził się w skale na szczycie góry." — Tessela, wiedźma z zachodnich stepów

Większość minotaurów gromadzi się z dala od cywilizacji w małe społeczności rolnicze lub rybackie.

Scrying
Legacy • 5th Level Divination (Cast at 5th Level)
Casting Time10 minutes
Durationup to 10 minutes
ComponentsV, S, M(a focus worth at least 1,000 gp, such as a crystal ball, a silver mirror, or a font filled with holy water)
RangeSelf
ConcentrationRequires Concentration
You can see and hear a particular creature you choose that is on the same plane of existence as you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, which is modified by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it. If a target knows you're casting this spell, it can fail the saving throw voluntarily if it wants to be observed.

On a successful save, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this spell against it again for 24 hours.
On a failed save, the spell creates an invisible sensor within 10 feet of the target. You can see and hear through the sensor as if you were there. The sensor moves with the target, remaining within 10 feet of it for the duration. A creature that can see invisible objects sees the sensor as a luminous orb about the size of your fist.
Instead of targeting a creature, you can choose a location you have seen before as the target of this spell. When you do, the sensor appears at that location and doesn't move.

messages.content:
Relentless Rage
Class
Starting at 11th level, your rage can keep you fighting despite grievous wounds. If you drop to 0 hit points while you’re raging and don’t die outright, you can make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw. If you succeed, you drop to 1 hit point instead.
Each time you use this feature after the first, the DC increases by 5. When you finish a short or long rest, the DC resets to 10.
